generation.description: The generation every sequence in this response belongs to. A cursor from another generation is stale, not a position in this one.

complete.description: Whether the rows are the whole conversation. A ready entry with no rows is a real empty conversation; anything else is partial.

reason.description: Why the conversation is not fully available, when it is not.

status.description: How much of the conversation the server can offer, and whether a newer view is being loaded.
